angle.doc: Degrees for + - & ^ \ /; also the variable a

apply_color.doc: Give every point a colour Cd looked up in the Image File at the turtle's U and V

apply_tube_texture_coordinates.doc: Tube only: write vertex uv (around the tube, along its length)

branch_blend.doc: Accepted for Houdini parity. Tubes do not blend into their parent yet

cols.doc: Cross sections one F is cut into

context_ignore.doc: Symbols skipped when matching the context of a rule

context_includes_siblings.doc: Let rule contexts see across branches ([A]Q[B])

continuous_angles.doc: Scale the angles turned by the last rewrite by the fractional part of Generations

continuous_length.doc: Scale the lengths moved by the last rewrite by the fractional part of Generations

continuous_width.doc: Scale the widths made by the last rewrite by the fractional part of Generations

generations.doc: Rewrites to apply. A fraction grows the last rewrite partway when the Continuous options are on

geometry_type.doc: Alias for type; kept for backwards compatibility

gravity.doc: Tropism of T towards -Z; also the variable T

group_prefix.doc: The g command makes primitive groups named <prefix><number>

initial_orientation.doc: Initial turtle yaw, pitch, roll in degrees, applied in that order; zero starts along +Z

leaf_param_a.doc: Point attribute that receives the 3rd value of J/K/M(s,x,a,b,c)

leaf_param_b.doc: Point attribute that receives the 4th value of J/K/M(s,x,a,b,c)

leaf_param_c.doc: Point attribute that receives the 5th value of J/K/M(s,x,a,b,c)

pic_image_file.doc: Image read by the pic() function

pitch.doc: Degrees for & (down) and ^ (up), in the turtle frame

point_attributes.doc: Skeleton only: also write segs, div, lage, arc, up and gen on the points

random_scale.doc: Randomly scales the lengths of F and the other moves by up to this fraction

random_seed.doc: For stochastic rules, ~ and Random Scale

read_rules_from_file.doc: Read the rules from the Rule File instead of the Rules box

roll.doc: Degrees for backslash and /, around the current heading

rows.doc: Sides of a tube (3: swept triangles)

rule_file.doc: One rule per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored

seed.doc: Alias for random_seed; kept for backwards compatibility

separate_angles.doc: Use independent yaw, pitch and roll angles instead of Angle

step.doc: Alias for step_size; kept for backwards compatibility

step_scale.doc: Alias for step_size_scale; kept for backwards compatibility

tension.doc: Accepted for Houdini parity. Tubes are straight per F, so it has no effect yet

thickness.doc: Starting width (point attribute 'width', used by sweep; a tube's diameter)

thickness_scale.doc: Factor applied by !, and by each [ branch

type.doc: skeleton: polyline curves; tube: polygon tubes around them

uv_increment_u.doc: What the ' command adds to U

uv_increment_v.doc: What the # command adds to V

variables.doc: More expression variables, one 'name=value' per line (a name is letters, digits and _; chan(i) reads <Channel Prefix>i)

vertical_increment.doc: What lage and the tube's V coordinate grow by per F

width.doc: Alias for thickness; kept for backwards compatibility

width_scale.doc: Alias for thickness_scale; kept for backwards compatibility

yaw.doc: Degrees for + (left) and - (right), in the turtle frame
